input.query: SELECT experiment_id, variant, channel, COUNT(*) n, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) conv, AVG(margin_60d_eur) margin, AVG(bonus_cost_eur) bonus, SUM(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) conversions, SUM(bonus_cost_eur) total_bonus FROM fct_experiment_users GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3,2
